name: DRIVEN_2D_BILLIARDS_TABLE_ARRAY_V1
drive: Declared external acceleration, integrated by the existing physics path: table COM x +/-0.75 and y +/-0.5 reverses every 64 ticks with a seeded table phase. Mixed/clustered add balanced +/-0.5 internal x acceleration, reversing every 48 ticks. No direct position or velocity animation after initialization.
topology_reservation: Explicit closed-table upper bound: 120 unique body pairs plus 64 wall constraints per complete 16-ball table. Candidate reservation is separate. Not a capacity claim for arbitrary scenes.
geometry: Separate closed physical tables, each 1.5 x 1.0, on a population-scaled 4-unit grid. Local accessible-area occupancy is 16*pi*radius^2/1.5 = 13.08997%. Also report bounding-world occupancy including gaps. Table coordinates are stored in cold tag field12 and remain stable through compaction.
qualification: UNVERIFIED until GPU evolving and independent coverage tests complete; these parameters are fixed for scene version1.
